summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 10.2 to Angular 11.2 with `ng update @angular/core@11 @angular/cli@11`, which ran the v11 core migrations (relativeLinkResolution, `async` to `waitForAsync` in the specs) and the CLI v11 workspace migrations (removed the dropped `extractCss` options from angular.json, refreshed the test/lint dev dependencies). @ngrx/* was moved to 11.1.1 so NgRx matches Angular 11. install and build pass from a clean node_modules; tests still fail exactly as at baseline, for the same pre-existing reason.
changes: ng update @angular/core@11 @angular/cli@11 bumped all @angular/* packages to 11.2.14 and @angular-devkit/build-angular to 0.1102.19.

Core v11 migration added the explicit `{ relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy' }` option to RouterModule.forRoot in src/app/app.module.ts, preserving the v10 routing behaviour now that the default changed to 'corrected'.
Core v11 migration renamed the deprecated `async` testing helper to `waitForAsync` in add-employee, counter and fetch-employee component specs.
CLI v11 workspace migration removed the `extractCss` option (removed in v11, now always on) from both build configurations in angular.json.
Workspace dependency refresh from the v11 migration: karma 6.4, jasmine-core 3.6, @types/jasmine 3.6, codelyzer 6.
Ran ng update @ngrx/store@11, moving all five @ngrx/* packages from 10.1.2 to 11.1.1; no NgRx code migrations applied.
package-lock.json regenerated through npm; verified by deleting node_modules and running a clean npm install followed by npm run build.
manual_followups: `npm run test` still fails exactly as at baseline: angular.json's test target lists "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so the CLI aborts with ENOENT before karma starts. Left untouched to keep this hop to the upgrade; worth fixing on its own.

`relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy'` was added by the migration to preserve behaviour. It is removed in Angular 15, so the routerLink resolution should be checked and the option dropped before that hop.

@nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader is still pinned at 7.1.0 with an unsatisfied peer on @angular/platform-server ^7.1.4 and is a no-op under Ivy. Dropping ModuleMapLoaderModule from app.server.module.ts is still pending from earlier hops and will likely become mandatory soon.
The build still warns that src/main.ts depends on @angular/platform-server as a CommonJS dependency; harmless, silenceable with allowedCommonJsDependencies.
A runtime smoke test of the CRUD screens is worth doing, since the build only proves compilation.
